neighbours.label: The speaker's own stance marker: 'To me,' or 'sounds good to me' giving an opinion, with 'At one point' also firing; recipient 'to me' stays quiet
fire: Honestly, the ending felt rushed. To me, it ruined the film.
We can leave at six. That sounds fine to me.
Some call it art. To me it is just a pile of bricks.
The new logo looks great to me, for what it's worth.
Critics loved the show, but to me the jokes fell flat.
It all makes sense to me now, after reading the report.
To me, the question is whether the plan is honest.
Pizza again tonight? Sounds perfect to me.
quiet: Honestly, the ending felt rushed. Then he ruined the film.
We can leave at six. My sister handed the keys to me.
Some call it art. They gave it to me for my birthday.
The new logo was sent over to me, along with the invoice.
Critics loved the show, and my boss mailed the tapes to me.
It all came back to me by post, after reading the report.
Then she passed the question to me in front of the class.
Pizza again tonight? Bring two slices to me.
